title: Create Image Comparison Node - side-by-side comparison of two images with slider overlay
description: Build a new node type that accepts two image inputs and displays them in a side-by-side comparison view with a draggable slider overlay. Include zoom sync between both images and a swap button.

title: Add Batch Variations Node - generate multiple image variations from single prompt
description: Create a node that takes an image and prompt, generates N variations (configurable 2-8), and outputs them as a grid. Include progress indicator and ability to select/favorite individual results.

title: Implement Conditional Branch Node - if/else logic based on image analysis
description: Build a conditional node that analyzes input image properties (dimensions, dominant color, brightness) and routes to different output handles based on conditions. Support AND/OR logic for multiple conditions.

title: Create Color Palette Extraction Node - extract and apply color palettes
description: Build a node that extracts dominant colors from an image (5-10 colors) and outputs them as a palette. Include ability to apply extracted palette to another image via color mapping.

title: Add Loop/Iterator Node - repeat operations N times or over collections
description: Create a loop node that can iterate a connected subgraph N times, passing iteration index and previous output to next iteration. Support for accumulating results into a gallery output.

title: Implement Mask/Inpainting Node - selective image editing with brush masks
description: Build a node with mask painting interface using Konva. User paints areas to edit, connects prompt describing changes. Integrates with Gemini inpainting API. Include mask feathering and expansion controls.

title: Build Image Filter Effects Node - apply visual filters and adjustments
description: Create a node with sliders for brightness, contrast, saturation, hue rotation, blur, sharpen. Include preset filters (vintage, noir, vivid). Real-time preview as user adjusts.

title: Add Workflow Template Gallery - browse and import templates
Implement Undo/Redo System with Cmd+Z shortcuts
